title: Everybody's Birthday
synopsis: Jake realizes he doesn't know when half his friends' birthdays are and decides the fix is to throw one party for all of them, today.
plot:
Jake wakes up with a nagging thought: he has never once thrown BMO a birthday party. Or Peppermint Butler. Or Lemongrab. He starts a list and it gets very long. Finn suggests just asking people their birthdays, and Jake says that would take forever and also that's not the point. The point is that everybody deserves a birthday and today is as good as any.

Jake stretches himself across Ooo delivering invitations to a party that starts in three hours. Bubblegum protests that she has meetings. Marceline says she doesn't do birthdays. Lemongrab says the concept is unacceptable. Demon Cat says he was approximately expecting this. Everyone comes anyway.

The party is enormous and disorganized and there are forty cakes because Tree Trunks panicked. Jake stands on a table and gives a toast: he doesn't know when any of them were born, and he doesn't care, because the day he met each of them is the day that counts, and he remembers every one of those. Then he forgets Cinnamon Bun's and has to make one up. Nobody minds. BMO blows out the candles on all forty cakes and makes forty wishes, and won't say what any of them were.
transcriptText:
Jake: Finn. Finn, wake up. When's BMO's birthday?
Finn: [half asleep] I dunno, man. Does BMO have one?
Jake: EXACTLY. And Pep Butt? And Lemongrab? Finn, I have never thrown Lemongrab a birthday party.
Finn: Nobody has thrown Lemongrab a birthday party.
Jake: That's a problem! That's a problem I'm fixing! Today!
Finn: You could just ask people when their birthdays are.
Jake: That's not the POINT. The point is everybody gets a birthday. Today. All of them. One party.
[Jake stretches across the land, dropping invitations.]
Princess Bubblegum: Three hours? Jake, I have four meetings—
Jake: [already gone] Bring the meetings!
Marceline: I don't do birthdays.
Jake: It's not YOUR birthday, it's EVERYBODY'S.
Marceline: ...That's a loophole. Fine.
Lemongrab: A birthday for ALL? UNACCEPTABLE. ...What time?
Demon Cat: I was approximately expecting this.
Jake: Then approximately be there!
[The Grass Lands. Forty cakes on a long table.]
Tree Trunks: I didn't know how many to make, so I made all of them.
Ice King: Is this for me? Is somebody finally throwing ME a party?
Finn: It's for everybody, Ice King.
Ice King: [tearing up] That includes me!
Lumpy Space Princess: Where's MY cake? Which one's MY cake?
BMO: They are all everybody's cake, LSP.
Lumpy Space Princess: Ugh, COMMUNISM.
[Jake climbs onto the table.]
Jake: Okay! Okay, everybody! I don't know when any of you were born. I don't! But I know the day I met every single one of you. Bonnie, you were yelling at a Banana Guard. Marcy, you tried to eat my house. Pep Butt, you were doing something in the basement I still don't wanna know about.
Peppermint Butler: Wise.
Jake: Lemongrab, you screamed at me for an hour. Demon Cat, you tried to eat Finn's eyeballs.
Demon Cat: Approximately.
Jake: And Cinnamon Bun, you were... uh... you were...
Cinnamon Bun: I was falling off a thing!
Jake: You were falling off a thing! And I loved you immediately. Happy birthday, everybody!
[Cheering. BMO leans over the first cake.]
BMO: I will now make forty wishes.
Finn: What are you wishing for, BMO?
BMO: [blowing out candles] That is between BMO and the cakes.
